service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_ID AS SIGNER_ID ,USMT.EMAIL AS SIGNER_EMAIL ,USMT.PHONE AS SIGNER_PHONE ,CMGL.IRS_NO AS SIGN_KEY ,CMGL.COMPANY_CODE AS SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE ,CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC AS SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME ,USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS SIGNER_NAME ,CMGL.CEO_NAME_LOC AS SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER ,CMGL.ADDRESS_LOC AS SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR ,CMGL.IRS_NO AS IRS_NO FROM SUSMT USMT INNER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USMT.USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT SIAD.* FROM(SELECT SMR_NUMBER , SMR_STATUS , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , APPLY_TYPE , SUBJECT , SUBMISSION_PLACE , REMARK , RCPT_TYPE , RCPT_REMARK , CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME , CONFIRM_USER_ID , SUBMIT_TYPE , SUBMIT_REMARK , RE_FLAG , REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE , LEGAL_WATERMARK , RE_DETAIL , REJECT_REASON , EXPLANATION , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ADD_USER_NAME , CASE WHEN ADD_USER_DEPT IS NULL THEN (SELECT U.DEPT FROM SUSMT U WHERE U.HOUSE_CODE = SSIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND U.COMPANY_CODE = SSIAD.COMPANY_CODE AND U.USER_ID = SSIAD.ADD_USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) ELSE ADD_USER_DEPT END AS ADD_USER_DEPT_CD , CASE WHEN ADD_USER_DEPT IS NULL THEN #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) ELSE #DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_DEPT, ${session.LANGUAGE}) END AS ADD_USER_DEPT , 'S' AS REQ_TYPE , DEL_FLAG FROM SSIAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} ) SIAD WHERE 1=1
AND SIAD.ADD_USER_ID = ${session.ID}
AND ( SIAD.ADD_USER_DEPT_CD = ${session.DEPARTMENT} OR SIAD.ADD_USER_ID = ${session.ID} )
AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(SIAD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = ${SMR_STATUS} AND SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE IN ($IN{REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE}) AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER NOT IN ( SELECT SOURCE_NO FROM SSCGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND SOURCE_NO IS NOT NULL )
AND ( SIAD.SUBJECT LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SIAD.SMR_NUMBER LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SIAD.SUBMISSION_PLACE LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SIAD.ADD_USER_NAME LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' )
AND SIAD.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SIAD.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} ORDER BY SIAD.SMR_NUMBER DESC

SELECT SETL.* FROM ( SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,SMR_NUMBER ,SMR_STATUS ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DEL_FLAG ,SIGN_STATUS ,SIGN_DATE ,SIGN_TIME ,SIGN_USER_ID ,APPLY_TYPE ,SUBJECT ,SEAL_USE_TYPE AS REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE ,SUBMISSION_PLACE ,ATTACH_NO ,REMARK ,LEGAL_REVIEW_TYPE ,CONFIRM_DATE ,CONFIRM_TIME ,CONFIRM_USER_ID ,SUBMIT_TYPE ,SUBMIT_REMARK ,EXT_USE_DETAIL ,EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE ,EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME ,EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE ,EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME ,EXT_USE_PLACE ,EXT_USE_USER_ID ,EXT_CPNO_USER_ID ,EXT_OUT_DATE ,EXT_OUT_TIME ,EXT_IN_DATE ,EXT_IN_TIME ,EMERGENCY_FLAG ,EMERGENCY_REMARK ,ROOT_PATH_TYPE ,REJECT_REMARK ,APVID ,ADD_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,ADD_DEPT_NAME_ENG ,CONFIRM_USER_DEPT ,CONFIRM_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,CONFIRM_DEPT_NAME_ENG ,EXT_USE_USER_DEPT ,EXT_USE_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,EXT_USE_DEPT_NAME_ENG , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ADD_USER_NAME , CASE WHEN ADD_USER_DEPT IS NULL THEN #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) ELSE #DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_DEPT, ${session.LANGUAGE}) END AS ADD_USER_DEPT , CASE WHEN ADD_USER_DEPT IS NULL THEN (SELECT U.DEPT FROM SUSMT U WHERE U.HOUSE_CODE = SSETL.HOUSE_CODE AND U.COMPANY_CODE = SSETL.COMPANY_CODE AND U.USER_ID = SSETL.ADD_USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) ELSE ADD_USER_DEPT END AS ADD_USER_DEPT_CD ,'E' AS REQ_TYPE FROM SSETL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} ) SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SETL.ADD_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE 1=1
AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = ${session.ID}
AND ( SETL.ADD_USER_DEPT_CD = ${session.DEPARTMENT} OR SETL.ADD_USER_ID = ${session.ID} )
AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(SETL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND SETL.SMR_STATUS = ${SMR_STATUS} AND SETL.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE IN ($IN{REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE}) AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER NOT IN ( SELECT SOURCE_NO FROM SSCGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND SOURCE_NO IS NOT NULL )
AND ( SETL.SUBJECT LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SETL.SMR_NUMBER LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SETL.ADD_USER_NAME LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' )
AND SETL.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SETL.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} ORDER BY SETL.SMR_NUMBER DESC

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,SMR_NUMBER ,SMR_STATUS ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DEL_FLAG ,APPLY_TYPE ,SUBJECT ,SUBMISSION_PLACE ,REMARK ,RCPT_TYPE ,RCPT_REMARK ,CONFIRM_DATE ,CONFIRM_TIME ,CONFIRM_USER_ID ,SUBMIT_TYPE ,SUBMIT_REMARK ,RE_FLAG ,REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE ,LEGAL_WATERMARK ,RE_DETAIL ,REJECT_REASON ,EXPLANATION ,ADD_USER_DEPT ,ADD_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,ADD_DEPT_NAME_ENG ,CONFIRM_USER_DEPT ,CONFIRM_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,CONFIRM_DEPT_NAME_ENG ,SOURCE_NO FROM SSIAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,SMR_NUMBER ,SMD_NUMBER ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DEL_FLAG ,SEAL_TYPE ,SEAL_MG_DEPT ,SUBJECT ,COUNT ,PRINT_COUNT ,DOWN_COUNT ,AUTO_PRINT_FLAG ,PUBLISH_NO ,REAL_ATTACH_NO ,ITEMS_JSON ,MARK_COUNT ,RE_DETAIL ,OTHER_FILE_NO ,ACCESS_LINK FROM SSIPD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND SMD_NUMBER = $S{SMD_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,SMR_NUMBER ,SMR_STATUS ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DEL_FLAG ,SIGN_STATUS ,SIGN_DATE ,SIGN_TIME ,SIGN_USER_ID ,APPLY_TYPE ,SUBJECT ,SEAL_USE_TYPE ,SUBMISSION_PLACE ,ATTACH_NO ,REMARK ,LEGAL_REVIEW_TYPE ,CONFIRM_DATE ,CONFIRM_TIME ,CONFIRM_USER_ID ,SUBMIT_TYPE ,SUBMIT_REMARK ,EXT_USE_DETAIL ,EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE ,EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME ,EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE ,EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME ,EXT_USE_PLACE ,EXT_USE_USER_ID ,EXT_CPNO_USER_ID ,EXT_OUT_DATE ,EXT_OUT_TIME ,EXT_IN_DATE ,EXT_IN_TIME ,EMERGENCY_FLAG ,EMERGENCY_REMARK ,ROOT_PATH_TYPE ,REJECT_REMARK ,APVID ,ADD_USER_DEPT ,ADD_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,ADD_DEPT_NAME_ENG ,CONFIRM_USER_DEPT ,CONFIRM_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,CONFIRM_DEPT_NAME_ENG ,EXT_USE_USER_DEPT ,EXT_USE_DEPT_NAME_LOC ,EXT_USE_DEPT_NAME_ENG FROM SSETL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,SMR_NUMBER ,SMR_SEQ ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DEL_FLAG ,SEAL_TYPE ,SEAL_MG_DEPT ,SUBJECT ,COUNT ,ATTACH_NO ,MANAGE_NUMBER ,SMD_NUMBER ,SEAL_MG_USER_ID ,SEAL_MG_SUBJECT ,ATTACH2_NO FROM SSEDC WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND SMD_NUMBER = $S{SMD_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
